home.heroTitle: Find work in Belgium without a CV
home.heroSubtitle: Create a simple profile in your language and employers reach out to you. No cover letters needed.

home.step1Desc: Answer a few simple questions about your experience. No CV required.
home.step2Desc: We show jobs that fit your skills and where you live.
home.step3Desc: Send your application without a cover letter. It only takes a moment.
home.step4Desc: Reply to messages and arrange interviews right on the platform.
home.companiesDesc: Post a job and reach candidates ready to work. You only pay for results.
home.benefitNoCvDesc: You don't need a ready-made CV. A simple profile is enough.
home.benefitMultilangDesc: The platform works in Polish, Dutch, French and English.
home.benefitEasyApplyDesc: You apply with one click, without unnecessary paperwork.
home.benefitMatchingDesc: We show jobs that truly fit you.
home.benefitVerifiedDesc: We check companies so you feel safe.
home.faqQ1: Do I need a CV to use Pracuj.be?
home.faqA1: No. Instead of a CV, you fill in a short profile with your experience and skills. Employers can see it and contact you directly.
home.faqQ2: Is Pracuj.be free for job seekers?
home.faqA2: Yes. Creating a profile, searching for jobs and applying are completely free for candidates.
home.faqQ3: What languages does the platform support?
home.faqA3: You can use Pracuj.be in Polish, Dutch, French and English. Job offers are shown in your language.
home.faqQ4: Do I have to speak Dutch or French?
home.faqA4: Not always. Many employers accept candidates without local language skills. Use the filter to see jobs with no language requirement.
home.faqQ5: How do employers get in touch with me?
home.faqA5: After you apply or publish your profile, employers can message you directly on the platform to arrange the next steps.
